subject: Is every group in MEASUREMENT.json reachable by a mutation, or does some group pass unconditionally?
method: Each mutation is written over the artifact its group reads, s11-cmp-verdict.mjs is run as a child process, and the REAL artifact is restored. RESTORED-UNMUTATED is the control: every group must be PASS there, or the gate is red for an unrelated reason.
coupling_notes: Mutation F flips negativeArm AND control, and that coupling is CORRECT: the control group asserts the two probe-free arms are DISTINGUISHABLE, so silencing the confined arm must break it. Recorded rather than smoothed away.

Mutation B flips cmp04 AND cmp13, which is the point of CMP-04 depending on CMP-13: ONE catalog answers both cases. A mutation that flipped only one would be evidence a case was reading a summary rather than the catalog -- and the first version of the verdict script did exactly that. See the CMP-13 comment in s11-cmp-verdict.mjs.
Mutation I flips provenance AND artifacts, which is also correct: naming a foreign home breaks both the ownership check and the provenance check. It is the G-FIX-13 fixed-output-path trap.
